note: Bolivia: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa (Mexico 180 days, the UK and others 90, most 90 in a year); Hong Kong's take a visa on arrival for 30 days (by Hong Kong's Immigration Department); everyone else (Group 2) needs a visa beforehand from a Bolivian mission, and Group 3 nationals a further authorisation (both taken as a visa). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Bolivia
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Bolivia without a visa for the following period: 180 days Mexico 90 days Dominican Republic Honduras Palestine United Kingdom 90 days within any 180 days Russia 90 days within a year European Union member states (except Cyprus) Andorra Argentina Australia Brazil Canada Chile Colombia Costa Rica Ecuador El Salvador Iceland Israel Japan Liechtenstein Monaco New Zealand Norway Panama Paraguay Peru Philippines South Africa South Korea Suriname Switzerland Turkey United Arab Emirates United States Uruguay Vatican City Venezuela ... Citizens of countries in Group 2 must obtain a visa prior to arrival, obtained at any Bolivian embassy or consulate . ... According to the Hong Kong Immigration Department, citizens of Hong Kong can enter Bolivia with a visa on arrival for 30 days.
